name: Redshade turns Reap into Thresh and then Bloodshatter
contract: Redshade 524735 promises that using Reap transforms it into Thresh for 10 seconds, and its buff Thresh (Dummy) 525058 says so on the character. Casting Thresh then leaves Bloodshatter (Dummy) 525299 for the second step. Both are plain SPELL_AURA_DUMMY, so the module answers them: aura_ascension_reaper_redshade_spells owns the two transformed abilities for as long as the talent is taken, aura_ascension_reaper_redshade_transform moves the button with SMSG_SUPERCEDED_SPELL, and spell_ascension_reaper_redshade_reap sends the replacement when the client still casts the rank on the bar. The spellbook copy is what makes the cast legal at all: CMSG_CAST_SPELL is refused for a spell the caster does not have active, so a redrawn button alone spent a global cooldown and did nothing. Both transforms also read Generates 1 Soul Fragment and generating Runic Power, and neither record performs either, so ResourceGainRules pays them the way it pays every rank of Reap.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Thresh is not in the spellbook without the talent
The transform redraws the bar without rewriting it: the saved button is still Reap
Reap sent Thresh, which left the Bloodshatter step
The button the client now holds casts Bloodshatter for real
